thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Sev2: EU hosted inference 5xx spike — multiple customers reporting errors. auto-paging to #incidents, paging on-call.

dan-sre: on it. seeing 503s from gateway -> model pool in eu-west-1. initial mitigation: scaling disabled, queued requests piling. toggling autoscaler now.

dan-sre: quick check: running `kubectl get pods -n inference | grep eu-west-1` shows repeated OOMKills on node g4dn-*-3. suspect memory regression after yesterday's runtime patch.

alex-oncall: taking over paging. dan, leave the cluster in current state and capture heap dumps/logs, don't restart pods yet. I'll coordinate failover.

alex-oncall: routing policy applied to send traffic to eu-central-1 as fallback. pushing temporary routing rule (ttl 30s) to reduce customer impact.

sam-support: getting a steady stream of support tickets — top affected: AcmeGames (high volume), two other mid-market customers. telling support to pause retries on client side if possible.

lisa-pm: note: this coincides with yesterday's runtime v2.14 rollout to EU. tagging rollout in postmortem.

incident-bot: deploy-bot: rollback initiated for runtime v2.14 in eu-west-1 by @alex-oncall. CI job #4821 -> INF-1234

dan-sre: after rollback, pods started stabilizing. error rate down from 18% -> 0.7% over 6m. still trending.

alex-oncall: handoff to dan for root cause and remediation tracking. I'll join postmortem. next on-call window 1819003600 -> please update if anything changes.

dan-sre: creating incident ticket INF-1234 in tracker and action items: 1) revert change in kernel allocator (done), 2) add memory headroom to EU pools, 3) e2e test for recent patch. assigning dan-sre, eng-runtime, eng-sre.

lisa-pm: scheduling postmortem discussion: Friday 09:30 UTC in #postmortems. please add notes in INF-1234 and bring Prometheus/Grafana panels.

maya-finance: tagging here for SLA/billing impact. need a preliminary estimate of impacted customers, duration of degradation, and token/billing units that failed vs succeeded. We'll compute credits.

sam-support: support logs show ~2.3M failed token requests across 6 hours (2027-06-01T01:12Z -> 2027-06-01T07:28Z) for eu-west-1. AcmeGames had ~12% of failures. sending CSV to maya.

maya-finance: thanks. for SLA credit calc we need: 1) precise start/end time of customer-facing impact, 2) list of customer account IDs and % of requests failed, 3) any retried requests that eventually succeeded (affects billable tokens).

dan-sre: will export request logs and correlate with billing logs. expect to drop RI export into INF-1234 by EOD. ticket FIN-4321 created for billing adjustments.

billing-bot: [ACTION REQUIRED] FIN-4321 created: assign to billing-team. Attach SLA calculation sheet and evidence.

maya-finance: rough plan: once logs and counts are in FIN-4321, Finance will draft credit estimates and route to Sales/AM for customer comms. Need approvals from legal for enterprise cases — @lisa-pm please coordinate for AcmeGames.

lisa-pm: will loop in customer success and legal. AcmeGames assigned to AM @tanya (cc'd via email). we'll propose a credit equal to 10% of June billed inference for AcmeGames as preliminary, pending final calc.

sam-support: support thread templates ready. we'll offer workaround guidance and include staged credit language. can send immediate apology + credit offer once finance confirms numbers.

dan-sre: postmortem action items (short): - add automated fallback to central region on spike, - implement memory regression unit tests, - hard-limits on recent allocator subset, - update runbook to include rollback steps. I'll add owner and ETA per item.

maya-finance: timeline expectations: we aim to present credit proposal to Sales by Monday COB. final credit application to invoices by next billing cycle. if legal needs more, might delay.

alex-oncall: final confirmation: service stabilized, no further customer-visible errors in last 45m. closing the live incident channel but keeping this thread for post-incident coordination.

lisa-pm: postmortem doc stub: https://docs.internal/redwood/postmortems/INF-1234 (please populate before Friday). add exec summary and customer impact table.

dan-sre: uploaded logs, heap dumps, and prom snapshots to INF-1234. linking to FIN-4321 for billing: https://tracker.internal/FIN-4321

maya-finance: received CSV from sam-support and logs from dan. starting preliminary credit calc now. please tag any additional affected accounts in FIN-1234.

billing-bot: [NOTIFICATION] Finance will need account-level invoice IDs to apply manual credits. please attach to FIN-1231.

sam-support: attaching accountIDs and high-level ticket links in FIN-1231. will follow-up with AMs for customer-specific language.

lisa-pm: action owners: dan-sre (root cause & runbook) / eng-runtime (tests & hard-limits) / sam-support (customer comms) / maya-finance (credit calc + approvals). put ETA column in INF-1234.

maya-finance: once we have final numbers, Finance will produce a customer credit memo and notify Accounting to adjust June invoicing. tracking code: SLA-20270601-EU

alex-oncall: good job team. drop any follow-ups into INF-1234. re-open channel if errors reappear.

incident-bot: [CLOSED] Incident INF-1234: stabilized and mitigated. Postmortem scheduled.
